Specific_Source_Or_Standard: TI TAS5805M Datasheet (SLVSEH8B); MPS MP3426 Datasheet; DOC03 REQ-P0-01
Derivation_Methodology_And_Conditions: 12.0V nominal + 10% tolerance margin. TAS5805M Recommended Max is 26.4V (Abs Max 30V); MP3426 SW Abs Max is 22V. Sequence: 3.3V stable -> 12V Boost enable -> I2S clock -> PDN HIGH.
Probe_Protocol_And_Grounding_Safety: Passive 10:1 probe on TP_PVDD with ground clip strictly on PCB TP_GND. Single-sequence trigger on 3.3V rising edge.
Engineering_Risks_If_Unverified: Zero-load boost instability or improper compensation (R10/C10) can cause resonant ringing exceeding MLCC 16V/25V ratings.

Test_Parameter_Name: VBUS Input Voltage Droop & Power Limit
Round3_Acceptance_Criteria: VBUS >= 4.50V droop threshold; Continuous Total Power <= 10.0W (Iin <= 2.0A at 5.0V)
Specific_Source_Or_Standard: USB-IF Type-C Specification; DOC03 REQ-P0-02; FMEA FM-01
Derivation_Methodology_And_Conditions: USB Type-C vSafe5V allows droop down to 4.40V-4.50V at peripheral end after cable loss. 4.50V ensures AP2112K 3.3V LDO dropout (250mV) and MP3426 boost regulation margin.
Probe_Protocol_And_Grounding_Safety: Kelvin 4-wire connection across R_SHUNT1 pads. Isolate USB power analyzer from ground loops.
Engineering_Risks_If_Unverified: If total continuous power exceeds 10.0W wall adapter triggers OCP or folds back VBUS causing brownout reset.

Test_Parameter_Name: BTL Audio Differential Output Flyback Surge
Round3_Acceptance_Criteria: V_surge <= 14.0V peak; No negative undershoot < -0.3V; Snubber damping zeta >= 0.7
Derivation_Methodology_And_Conditions: PVDD is 12.0V. High-side body diode clamps to PVDD+0.7V (~12.7V). 14.0V provides 1.3V margin below TAS5805M 30V absolute maximum rating.
Probe_Protocol_And_Grounding_Safety: CRITICAL: NEVER attach standard scope ground clip to OUTA or OUTB! Must use active differential probe or Scope Math (Ch1-Ch2) with clips strictly on PCB GND.
Engineering_Risks_If_Unverified: Inductive kickback from 4-exciter voice coil (L=0.36mH) during ESTOP can punch through H-bridge MOSFETs if RC snubber is miscalculated.

Round3_Acceptance_Criteria: V_SW_peak <= 18.0V (18.2% margin below 22V Abs Max); Settling time <= 50ns
Specific_Source_Or_Standard: MPS MP3426 Datasheet Section 6.1 (Abs Max Ratings)
Derivation_Methodology_And_Conditions: MP3426 internal power FET breakdown occurs at >22.0V. 18.0V is a conservative engineering derating target (22V - 4V margin) under Vin=4.5V and max load.
Probe_Protocol_And_Grounding_Safety: MANDATORY: Standard 10cm alligator ground clip CANNOT be used (adds 100nH loop picking up 5-10V false ringing). Must use short spring ground tip (<5mm).
Engineering_Risks_If_Unverified: Parasitic inductance between SW pin diode D3 and C6 causes inductive spike exceeding 22V destroying MP3426 internal FET.

Test_Parameter_Name: Boost Inductor Dynamic Peak & RMS Current
Specific_Source_Or_Standard: Sunlord SWPA6045S-4R7NT Datasheet; MP3426 Inductor Calculation
Derivation_Methodology_And_Conditions: Sunlord inductor Isat=3.6A (-30% L drop); Irms=3.0A (+40C rise). Boost model: Ipeak = Iin + Delta_I/2. 2.65A cont / 3.10A worst-case calculated at Vin=4.5V.
Probe_Protocol_And_Grounding_Safety: High-frequency AC/DC Hall-effect current probe (>=50MHz) clamped on inserted wire loop in series with L1.
Engineering_Risks_If_Unverified: Core saturation causes inductance to collapse to air-core level (<1uH) causing current to spike into MP3426 4A-6A switch limit destroying the IC.

Test_Parameter_Name: 3.3V LDO Rail Transient Dip During Wi-Fi Burst
Round3_Acceptance_Criteria: Delta_V <= 100mV (<=3.0% dip); V_min >= 3.10V at all times
Specific_Source_Or_Standard: Espressif ESP32-WROOM-32E/32UE Datasheet; DOC03 REQ-P1-08; FMEA FM-07
Derivation_Methodology_And_Conditions: ESP32 operating range is 3.0V-3.6V. Brownout detector trips at 2.80V. 100mV maximum drop on 3.3V rail guarantees >=3.20V maintaining >400mV margin above brownout.
Probe_Protocol_And_Grounding_Safety: DSO AC-coupled (50mV/div) with ground spring tip directly across C3 pads within 2mm of ESP32 VDD pin.
Engineering_Risks_If_Unverified: Wi-Fi 802.11b TX pulses (380-500mA for 1-2ms) cause LDO voltage drop below 2.8V triggering unexpected MCU resets.

Test_Parameter_Name: USB Type-C CC Logic & Hot-Plug Inrush Voltage
Round3_Acceptance_Criteria: 5.1kOhm pull-down on CC1/CC2; VBUS hot-plug overshoot <= 5.75V
Specific_Source_Or_Standard: USB Type-C Cable and Connector Specification Rel 2.1 Table 4-36; DOC03 REQ-P0-06
Derivation_Methodology_And_Conditions: USB-C standard mandates 5.1kOhm +/- 10% pull-down on CC1 and CC2. Hot-plug LC resonance with long USB cable must not exceed 5.75V (USB-PD transient tolerance).
Probe_Protocol_And_Grounding_Safety: DSO 2-channel 10:1 passive probes on CC1/CC2 and VBUS. Connect ground strictly to receptacle shield tab before mating connector.
Engineering_Risks_If_Unverified: Non-compliant CC resistors (such as 14k in earlier schematic) cause pure USB-C PD chargers to deliver 0V. Hot-plug ringing >6.5V destroys AP2112K LDO.

Round3_Acceptance_Criteria: U3 (MP3426) Tc <= 85.0C; U4 (TAS5805M) Tc <= 75.0C; U2 (AP2112K) Tc <= 70.0C; Enclosure Outer Wall <= 40.0C
Specific_Source_Or_Standard: MP3426 / TAS5805M / AP2112K Datasheets; IEC 62368-1; ISO 13732-1 infant touch safety
Derivation_Methodology_And_Conditions: IEC 62368-1 restricts infant-touchable plastic surface to <=40C. Component case temperatures (85C/75C/70C) are engineering derating targets assuming Ta=40C in sealed housing.
Probe_Protocol_And_Grounding_Safety: Calibrated FLIR thermal imaging camera + calibrated K-type thermocouples attached with thermal epoxy. Enclosure sealed for 60 minutes.
Engineering_Risks_If_Unverified: Thermal runaway in sealed plastic enclosure; AP2112K SOT-25-5 junction temperature exceeding 125C causing thermal shutdown; outer bassinet wall exceeding 40C burning infant skin.

Round3_Acceptance_Criteria: Normal Soothing L_Aeq <= 50.0dBA at 30cm; Maximum Volume L_AFmax <= 65.0dBA (Emergency ceiling)
Specific_Source_Or_Standard: Hugh et al. (Pediatrics 2014); AAP Committee on Environmental Health 1997; 2023 AAP Policy Statement
Derivation_Methodology_And_Conditions: Hugh et al. cited 50dBA hospital nursery guideline. 50dBA is an internal candidate target at 30cm; NOT official AAP product certification. 65dBA is unapproved. 75dBA permanently REJECTED.
Probe_Protocol_And_Grounding_Safety: Type 1 / Class 1 Calibrated Sound Level Meter (IEC 61672-1) in semi-anechoic room. Microphone at 30cm on-axis from mattress center. Background noise <30dBA.

Test_Parameter_Name: Bassinet Surface Vibration Acceleration & ESTOP Delay
Round3_Acceptance_Criteria: a_RMS <= 0.15g (Insensible micro-vibration; NOT 0.5g); Emergency shutdown delay <= 100ms upon shock trigger
Specific_Source_Or_Standard: Kimura et al. (2017); DOC03 Baseline; docs/FAULT_MATRIX.md
Derivation_Methodology_And_Conditions: Kimura 2017 studied 0.5Hz gentle rocking (2.4mm-7.5mm stroke); NOT 45Hz exciter vibration. 0.15g does not derive from 10-15um without explicit frequency and load. 100ms ESTOP delay is firmware task target.
Probe_Protocol_And_Grounding_Safety: Triaxial ICP accelerometer (sensitivity 100mV/g) mounted rigidly to center of mattress frame under loaded conditions (5kg infant dummy). Dynamic signal analyzer.
Engineering_Risks_If_Unverified: Uncontrolled mechanical vibration causes infant brain/organ oscillation or sleep disturbance; false ESTOP triggers disrupt infant soothing.
